answer: Make every agent prove itself by sonar: a newcomer must answer timed pings sent from unrelated verifiers scattered across the ocean, each reply triangulated so a copied identity is exposed at once. Each verified ping returns an echo receipt, and only echoes from widely spread sources count, so one clique cannot vouch for thousands. A whisper chain carries each receipt onward, with every link re-checking the last, so tampering breaks the chain. Sybil farms must answer real pings, spread real verifiers, and keep every whisper true for each clone, costing more than honest work pays.
